Listed as a co-sponsor (not primary) of Senate Bill 715, Student Voter ID Grant Program/CCs. The bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/Senate/HTML/S715v0.html) appropriates $500,000 for grants of up to $20,000 to community colleges to produce student ID cards that can be used to vote in person under G.S. 163-166.16, and directs the State Board of Elections to review community college applications to approve student IDs as photo ID. Referred to the Appropriations/Base Budget committee.
